Steps: Install the APK on a fresh phone and open it.
Expected result: Language picker shows BM and EN; after choosing, splash then main menu appear.

Steps: Menu > Settings > change language BM to EN.
Expected result: All menu text changes to English at once; no key names (e.g. 'menu.play') shown.

Steps: Start Bab 1. Swipe left and right (or press A/D).
Expected result: The Geng moves one lane per swipe; never leaves the 3 lanes.

Steps: During a run, tap the screen.
Expected result: Leader rotates Aiman > Mei > Kavitha; HUD portrait updates.

Steps: Bab 1: put Mei in front and run into a smoke threat.
Expected result: Threat is destroyed, score +100, combo grows; Semangat does not drop.

Steps: Bab 1: put Aiman in front and run into smoke.
Expected result: Semangat drops; combo resets; Oyen tip appears on the first wrong hit.

Steps: Collect a teh tarik bag.
Expected result: Semangat goes up and never above the maximum.

Steps: New save: play Bab 1.
Expected result: Swipe prompt, then smoke in your lane with a hand hint until Mei leads; tutorial ends after the first match.

Steps: Settings > Replay tutorial, then play Bab 1.
Expected result: 'Langkau / Skip' pill shows its text and skips the tutorial (regression of BUG-009).

Steps: Make 5 right-friend matches.
Expected result: Power meter fills; power button lights up; Oyen explains the power once.

Steps: Use Aiman, Mei and Kavitha powers when full.
Expected result: Fact Check clears scams; Air Shield clears smoke + 3 s shield; Calm Mode slows the world and refills Semangat.

Steps: Pick up a Kad Ilmu during a run.
Expected result: Popup shows for about 2 s while the world slows; card is saved even if you quit the run.

Steps: Pick up a card, then lose within 2 s.
Expected result: Popup closes; it does not stay on the Result screen (regression of BUG-001).

Steps: Bab 2: hit a scam with the wrong friend.
Expected result: Short freeze, slow-motion replay with a red-flag label and Aiman's line; tap skips the slow part.

Steps: Pause, tap Sambung (Resume), keep the finger down.
Expected result: The same tap does not swap the leader or skip the replay (regression of BUG-002).

Steps: Reach the end of Bab 1 and Bab 2.
Expected result: Boss enters, health bar shows, matches cut its time, boss leaves and the chapter clears.

Steps: Play Bab 5 and take several wrong hits.
Expected result: Water creeps closer; touching the Geng fails the run with a 'flooded' message.

Steps: Clear Bab 5.
Expected result: Villagers join the trail; relief centre shows; 'Penamat' plays the ending and credits.

Steps: Clear any chapter.
Expected result: Stars with reasons, distance bar, stats, cards found; only one title visible during card reveal (regression of BUG-008).

Steps: Clear Bab 1, open the chapter map.
Expected result: Bab 2 unlocks; stars for Bab 1 are kept; stars never go down on a worse run.

Steps: Play, close the app fully, reopen.
Expected result: Progress, cards and settings are still there.

Steps: Run where saving is not possible (e.g. storage blocked).
Expected result: A one-time warning in BM/EN says progress cannot be saved (regression of BUG-003).

Steps: Menu > Album Oyen, look at the tab row.
Expected result: 'Bonus' and 'Wardrobe/Closet' fit on one line (regression of BUG-005).

Steps: Menu > Settings, look under the Back button.
Expected result: No stray 'label' text (regression of BUG-006).

Steps: Open the main menu.
Expected result: Album button shows Oyen, not an empty orange circle (verify BUG-007 on a phone).

Steps: Press Android Back during a run, on a sub-screen and on the main menu.
Expected result: Run pauses; sub-screen goes back one step; the app only exits from the main menu.

Steps: During a run, switch to another app and come back.
Expected result: Game is paused and muted; nothing jumps forward on return.
